summary: On 1 February 2000 the newly created Coast Guard Administration (CGA) set up its Dongsha Command (東沙指揮部) and took over the garrison of Dongsha (Pratas) Island from the armed forces; the CGA later added radar and used its vessels to drive off boats fishing illegally in the atoll's waters.
actors: Coast Guard Administration (海巡署), Dongsha Command (東沙指揮部)
